name: ai-paladin
description: Shows the AI-Paladin router's egress posture in the status bar, and opens its console. Read-only: this extension never changes the posture.

aiPaladin.endpoint.markdownDescription: Base URL of the AI-Paladin router. The router binds to loopback only; pointing this at a remote host will not work and is not supported.

aiPaladin.pollSeconds.description: How often to read the router's posture while it is reachable. Backs off automatically while it is not.

aiPaladin.showWhenOffline.description: Keep the status bar item visible when the router is not running. Turn off to hide it entirely until the router comes up.
